application_credentials.description: Google Calendar needs your own OAuth client. In a [Google Cloud project]({oauth_creds_url}) enable the [Google Calendar API]({calendar_api_url}), set up the [consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}), and create an OAuth client of type *Web application* with the redirect URI `https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/oauth`. Enter its client ID and secret here.

account.title: Fajna Clinic account
account.description: Enter the phone number of the patient account. The clinic will text you a code.

data_description.phone: As in the patient account, e.g. +380 99 123 45 67

pin.title: Code from SMS
pin.description: Enter the code the clinic texted to {phone}.

password.title: Password
password.description: Enter the patient account password. It is sent to the clinic once and not stored.

persons.title: Patient cards
persons.description: The account of {phone} has several patient cards. Tick the ones to add to Home Assistant; you can change this later in the account's options.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The clinic has ended the session of {phone}. Continue to receive a new SMS code.

reauth_persons.title: Patient cards
reauth_persons.description: Signed in again. The cards already added are ticked: send the form as it is to keep them, or change the choice.

google_settings.title: Google Calendar
google_settings.description: Visits of the cards ticked below become events in this calendar, titled like «[Іван] Масаж спини». The people below are invited to each one without an email, so it shows in their calendars too. An invitee who has linked their own Google account here has the invitation accepted for them.

data_description.cards: Whose visits this calendar holds. A card already in another linked calendar is not offered.
data_description.calendar_id: «primary» is the main calendar of the linked account; another calendar's ID is in its Google settings.

reauth_google.title: Link Google again
reauth_google.description: Google no longer accepts the link. Sign in with the same Google account.

error.invalid_phone: The clinic did not accept this phone number.
error.invalid_pin: Wrong code. Check the SMS and try again.
error.invalid_email: One of the addresses is not an email address.
error.unknown: Unexpected answer from fajna.clinic. The site may have changed.

abort.unsupported_login: The clinic's login has changed and this version cannot complete it.
abort.no_persons: The account has no patient cards.
abort.add_account_first: Add a patient account first: the calendar holds its patient cards' visits.
abort.no_free_cards: Every patient card already has a calendar. To give a card a calendar of its own, untick it in the options of the Google link that holds it.
abort.wrong_google_account: That is a different Google account from the one linked.
abort.missing_credentials: Add Google credentials first: Settings → Application credentials.
abort.missing_configuration: Add Google credentials first: Settings → Application credentials.
abort.oauth_failed: Could not get a token from Google.
abort.oauth_timeout: Google did not answer in time.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The Google credentials are not available right now.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out creating the Google sign-in link.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL Google could return to. Check Settings → Network.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: Access to Google was not granted.

init.title: Google Calendar
init.description: Visits of the ticked cards are written to this calendar. Untick a card to remove its events from here.

data_description.cards: Whose visits this calendar holds. A card already in another linked calendar is not offered.
data_description.calendar_id: «primary» is the main calendar of the linked account.

persons.title: Patient cards
persons.description: Tick the patient cards to keep in Home Assistant. A card you untick is removed with its entities and its events in Google Calendar.

error.invalid_email: One of the addresses is not an email address.

abort.account_not_loaded: The account is not working right now (signed out or unreachable). Sign in again first.
abort.no_persons: The account has no patient cards.
abort.unknown: Unexpected answer from fajna.clinic. The site may have changed.
